name: GE Vernova Inc.
research_rationale: Same-day rebound and AI-power sentiment help narratively, but filed FY25 FCF still lags screen TTM FCF and Wind execution risk is unresolved, so research only partly supports the buy signal.

weekly_updates.summary:
News flow is mixed: commentaries cite higher 2026 Power/Electrification targets, while Wind losses, execution risk and a ~14% monthly share decline dominate recent headlines.
Erste Group reportedly downgraded GEV; HSBC had upgraded to Buy (Wind “past the worst”) in late October—both unverified beyond press summaries in the batch.
Sourced SEC annual cash flow is unchanged (FY2025 10-K OCF $4.99bn, FCF $3.71bn, dividends $275m); Yahoo TTM FCF remains far above filed annual FCF.

Same-day press cites an AI-energy rebound and fair-valuation debate after a cooled run; one piece frames GEV versus CAT as a deeper, riskier snapback—no new SEC filings in the batch.  
Filed FY2025 cash flow in sources is unchanged (OCF $4.99bn, FCF $3.71bn); Yahoo TTM FCF (~$17.1bn) still far exceeds annual filed FCF underpinning the screen.  
Wind execution and mixed analyst views noted earlier remain the main fundamental overhang; Nvidia leadership commentary is sentiment-only for order visibility.
